1. (Currently amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder __that is cured at a temperature above 150°C__; and a solvent.

2. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface.

3. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface.

9. (Currently amended) A composition comprising cavity generating particles, a binder __that is cured at a temperature above 150°C__, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio being about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier being about 10 ml per gram of particles.

10. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 9, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

11. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the binder is premixed solder paste __having a melting point above 200°C__.

12. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

13. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 pm in size.

14. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 pm in size.

15. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 __μ__m in size.

16. (Currently amended) A composition of matter comprising carrier, binder __that is cured at a temperature above 150°C__, and cavity generating particles, wherein said composition of matter contains, in relative proportion: about 10 ml carrier; about 0.5 to 0.8 grams binder; and about 1 gram of cavity generating particles.

17. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 16, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87.

18. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 16, wherein the binder is premixed solder paste __having a melting point above 200°C__.

19. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys.

20. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 pm in size.

21. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 30-50 p m in size.

22. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 16, wherein the cavity generating particles are 100-200 __μ__m in size.
